overview_description.description: Elphinstone serves as the community's investment robo-advisory platform. They provide investment services and products that are handled by companies that are likewise licensed asset management firms that have been registered and are subject to SECP regulation. They assist clients in purchasing community mutual funds with a track record of long-term success, run by some of the area's respected asset management firms.

product.name: Advised Investment Portfolios
product.description: Managed investment portfolios tailored to client risk preferences, including conventional and Shariah-compliant options, combining equity and fixed income ETFs.

product.name: Self-Directed Investment Accounts
product.description: Investment accounts allowing clients to independently manage and trade US stocks, bonds, and ETFs without advisory guidance.

identifier.value: US Stock and ETF Investment Access

product.name: US Stock and ETF Investment Access
product.description: A platform enabling individuals, especially Pakistanis, to invest in US stocks and exchange-traded funds through regulated brokerage partnerships.

product.name: Islamic (Shariah-Compliant) Investing
product.description: Investment portfolios structured to comply with Islamic finance principles, including Shariah-compliant equity and sukuk fixed income ETFs.

identifier.value: Financial Planning Software and Portfolio Management Services

product.name: Financial Planning Software and Portfolio Management Services
product.description: Digital tools and services for financial planning and portfolio management accessible via web and mobile applications.
